title: A Prom for the Homecoming
author: Felix Ishikawa
blurb: Jude Quintana, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
